generic.description: Default import profile for external datasets. It adds no dataset-specific waivers and relies on schema, QA, curation, cleanup, dry-run, and verification gates.

bafu.description: BAFU / FOEN import profile for BAFU 2025 ecoSpold1 converted TIDAS rows, using root TIDAS library-level entity indexing plus the converted process-bundles index for process-level closure, queue-lock parallelism, public-canonical-first support/elementary reuse with profile-authorized account-local state_code=0 candidates for defensible gaps, true-source-or-BAFU-database source attribution, one canonical FOEN/BAFU contact, deterministic source-only-output exchange proof when source rows support it, and task-policy-gated batch commit.

waiver_reasons.process_material_balance_deviation: BAFU profile treats process_material_balance_deviation as a source-data QA observation, not a remote-write blocker. Other schema, placeholder, reference, unit, required-field, and trace blockers remain blocking.

allow_account_local_support_and_elementa.authorized_by: user override 2026-06-15: build all buildable BAFU data as My Data (state_code=0) first, then cross-reference within the My Data scope during preparation. Explicit, reversible override of the reference-only support and elementary-flow-reuse governance for the BAFU account.
allow_account_local_support_and_elementa.note: Set enabled=false to restore reference-only governance. Does NOT relax either unit-scale safety blocker (canonical_support_amount_scaling_required for a known positive non-1 factor, or canonical_support_amount_scale_unresolved for a missing/non-finite/non-positive factor) or schema/curation/full-context proof gates — only the reference-only and elementary-create_new policy walls. Account-local rows are written at state_code=0 (My Data), keep their source units so amounts stay self-consistent, and remain in an account-local candidate registry outside the public canonical support cache until separately approved for promotion.
allow_account_local_support_and_elementa.report_policy: Canonical support and finalize reports must state public-canonical-first plus this scoped account-local exception when enabled; they must not emit an unconditional reference-only or no-My-Data policy. Any profile-specific owner-draft alias maintenance report must bind all logical batches into one guarded database-atomic plan with whole-plan audit and readback proof; it must not treat independently committed dimension batches as complete.

full_context_ai_completion.proof: dataset-identity-decision-task-build plus dataset-identity-decisions-apply with authoring_package_sha256 and closes_action_items evidence for identity-preflight decisions, dataset-classification-decisions-apply with matching classification decision task/context_bundle_sha256 for classification queues, dataset-location-decisions-apply with matching location decision task/context_bundle_sha256 for location queues, dataset-curation-cleanup deterministic proof for source-only-output exchange completeness when an explicit source rows file proves the source and final exchange signatures, or dataset-authoring-patch-collect plus dataset-patch-apply with authoring_package_sha256 and closes_action_items evidence for other field patches

uslci.description: USLCI import profile skeleton. It intentionally adds no dataset-specific code path or approved waivers until a pilot run proves them.

waiver_reasons.process_material_balance_deviation: User D3-QA decision 2026-06-24: treat process_material_balance_deviation as a source-data QA observation (warning), not a remote-write blocker, mirroring the BAFU profile. USLCI LCI_RESULT and amountFormula exchanges are imported in the first batch; their material balance is inherent to the source aggregation/formula model. Other schema, placeholder, reference, unit, required-field, and trace blockers remain blocking.

allow_account_local_support_and_elementa.authorized_by: user override 2026-06-23 (D4-elementary): build all buildable USLCI data as account-local My Data (state_code=0) — the 1,056 lever-2 scopes whose FEDEFL elementary flows / 7 local flow-properties / 4 unit-groups have no public canonical equivalent are minted as My Data rather than left non-importable. Explicit, reversible override of the reference-only support and elementary-flow-reuse governance for the USLCI account, mirroring the BAFU 2026-06-15 override.
allow_account_local_support_and_elementa.note: Set enabled=false to restore reference-only governance. Does NOT relax either unit-scale safety blocker (canonical_support_amount_scaling_required for a known positive non-1 factor, or canonical_support_amount_scale_unresolved for a missing/non-finite/non-positive factor) or schema/curation/full-context proof gates — only the reference-only and elementary-create_new policy walls. Account-local rows are written at state_code=0 (My Data) and keep their source units so amounts stay self-consistent.

full_context_ai_completion.proof: No USLCI-specific full-context AI proof override is approved yet; use generic curation and queue verification gates.

worldsteel.description: worldsteel EF3.1-reference native ILCD 1.1 package (33 steel LCI-result processes plus ~74 new product/waste/other and GaBi/Sphera pseudo-elementary flows) sitting on a large EF3.1 reference layer (~1,315 reference elementary flows, most flowproperties/unitgroups, 25 LCIA methods, and EF/PEF/OEF/ILCD compliance boilerplate). The reference layer is reused by its ORIGINAL canonical UUID through deterministic exchange-reference-rewrites (applyResolutionRewrites), never minted. Validation uses Rust tidas' locked corrected eILCD schemas, not raw EF3.1. Source binaries referenced via referenceToDigitalFile are uploaded to the external_docs storage bucket by the tiangong-lca-cli `dataset source upload-attachments` command and the source @uri rewritten before write. One canonical worldsteel library/attribution contact (reused from the package); worldsteel database fallback source.

waiver_reasons.process_material_balance_deviation: worldsteel profile treats process_material_balance_deviation as a source-data QA observation (warning), not a remote-write blocker, mirroring BAFU/USLCI. The 33 datasets are aggregated LCI_RESULT processes whose material balance is inherent to the source aggregation model. Other schema, placeholder, reference, unit, required-field, and trace blockers remain blocking.
waiver_reasons.source_locator_in_dataset_name: worldsteel source process names follow the convention '<product> <route> <geography> <data-year>' (e.g. 'Steel rebar Global 2022', 'Steel sections EU 2019', 'Steel ECCS Global 2021 v2'). The trailing '<Geography> <Year>' is reference metadata describing WHICH worldsteel LCI release the model represents, NOT a source citation locator, but it matches the prewrite-content-policy 'latin-author-year' marker ('<Word> <YYYY>'). All 33 source baseNames carry this pattern (preserved verbatim per R4). This waiver scopes ONLY the source_locator_in_dataset_name rule for process names; every other content-policy rule (foundry-workflow language, etc.) and all flow/lifecyclemodel names remain enforced.

allow_account_local_support_and_elementa.authorized_by: user decision 2026-06-29 (requirement 3): the ~1,315 EF3.1 reference elementary flows + canonical flowproperties/unitgroups are REUSED by their original canonical UUIDs (deterministic exchange-reference-rewrites + applyResolutionRewrites) and are NEVER minted. This override is a capped escape hatch scoped ONLY to the small residual of GaBi/Sphera pseudo-elementary flows (dataSetVersion 20.25.x) that have no canonical match — expected at most 17 — which are authored as account-local My Data (state_code=0) with full AI context so the 33 steel processes stay complete. These residual flows are NOT matched by UUID; the AI judges reuse-vs-mint from full context. Final mint count is reviewed after the UUID-reuse pass. Reversible (enabled=false).
allow_account_local_support_and_elementa.note: Unlike BAFU/USLCI (which mint reference support at scale because their FEDEFL/ecoSpold support has no public canonical equivalent), worldsteel's reference support and elementary flows ARE canonical and are reused by original UUID. This override exists only as a capped allowance for the <=17 unmatched GaBi/Sphera pseudo-elementary flows. Does NOT relax either unit-scale safety blocker (canonical_support_amount_scaling_required for a known positive non-1 factor, or canonical_support_amount_scale_unresolved for a missing/non-finite/non-positive factor) or schema/curation/full-context proof gates. Account-local rows are written at state_code=0 (My Data) keeping their source units. Set enabled=false to forbid all minting (then the residual flows externalize to common:other traces instead).

full_context_ai_completion.scoped_relaxation: 2026-06-30 user decision: R3's full-context requirement is the reuse-vs-mint IDENTITY DECISION, satisfied off-line by the adversarially-verified elementary-match + capped-mint workflows (decisions-v1/ai-elementary-match-result.json + ai-mint-flows.jsonl, per-flow evidence) plus full-context field authoring of the new product/waste flows, mints, and processes (treatmentStandardsRoutes / flowProperties / functionalUnitFlowProperties). worldsteel new entities are account-local My Data (state_code=0), NOT published canonical, so canonical-grade per-entity identity authoring-package binding (authoring_package_sha256) is not required. Set required=true to re-impose the strict per-mint identity authoring-package proof.
